There’s still time to score major deals during Amazon’s Black Friday Sale and countless other sales across all kinds of brands, and for the few we’ve rounded up here, there’s so much more waiting for you in our Black Friday Green Deals hub here . Below, you can find the EGO Nexus 1,400W Portable Inverter/Generator at a new $579 low , while Greenworks is offering up to 57% tool discounts starting from $40 , and Worx is offering up to 45% discounts starting from $29 . There’s also the latest Linkind Matter Outdoor Smart Plug at a new $22 low in time for holiday display needs, and plenty more.
Head below for other New Green Deals we’ve found today and, of course, Electrek ’s best EV buying and leasing deals . Also, check out the new Electrek Tesla Shop for the best deals on Tesla accessories .
EGO’s Nexus 1,400W portable inverter and generator charges batteries + powers devices at new $579 low ($120 off)
As Amazon’s Black Friday Sale continues, you can find the EGO Power+ Nexus 1,400W Portable Inverter/Generator (tool only) for $579 shipped . Down from $699, it’s mostly kept to that full price since launching at the top of the year, with a few falls to $599 on the books previously. No though, you’re able to score a larger-than-ever $120 markdown off the going rate, for a new all-time low price. You can find more EGO tool deals in the Amazon storefront here .
Expand one outlet into two with automation through Linkind’s latest Matter Outdoor Smart Plug down at $22
Only on the market for a little over two months, this Linkind outdoor smart plug has become quite popular, mostly due to its Matter inclusion for streamlining the in-app smart controls across the most popular ecosystems. Turning one outlet into two, you can use it to automate holiday displays and other everyday power needs, allowing you to remotely turn things on/off, set schedules to do so, and more.

Huge Greenworks Black Friday tool sale at Amazon kicks off from $40 (Up to 57% off)
While Amazon’s Black Friday Sale event is in full swing for the rest of the month, this makes it a great time to jump on Greenworks’ massive list of tool and accessory deals while seeing up to 57% discounts. You can find smaller cutting solutions like the 24V 6-inch Cordless Mini Chainsaw kit down at $89.99 shipped from $130, or find newer options like the latest 24V 12-inch Cordless Snow Shovel at its $178 low , and so many others from across its massive arsenal.
Check out this full Greenworks Black Friday tool deal lineup right here .
Save up to 45% on Worx tools during Amazon’s Black Friday Sale – deals start from $29
As part of Amazon’s ongoing Black Friday Sale event , you can currently bolster your Worx arsenal with up to 45% discounts across a wide variety of tools. There are plenty of notable deals, like the 20V 10-inch 2-in-1 Cordless Electric Chain and Pole Saw down at $123.49 shipped , in addition to this corded Trivac 3-in-1 Electric Leaf Blower, Vacuum, and Mulcher with a LeafPro collection system down at $67.99 shipped , and more.
Be sure to browse the massive Worx Black Friday tool sale lineup here .
Grab the handy BougeRV portable 3,200mAh area light + power bank at its newest $21 low right now
EGO’s Z6 42-inch cordless zero-turn riding mower + 6x batteries and wall charger drops to $4,499 low ($801 off), more
Worx’s 40V 20-inch Cordless PowerShare snow blower + 2x batteries just hit a new $350 low for Black Friday
All three ECOVACS LiDAR Pro robot lawn mowers hit lowest prices for Black Friday starting from $949
Black Friday 2026 Green Deals Hub: e-bikes, EVs, power stations, tools, appliances, and more
